title: Machine learning selects silver-electrode CO₂ electrolysis conditions
summary: A model trained on 56 experimental observations selected electrode-fabrication and electrolysis conditions for silver-catalyzed CO₂ reduction. Researchers experimentally validated the proposed conditions against a desired hydrogen-to-carbon-monoxide ratio and CO efficiency. This is an assay-specific process-optimization result for a known silver catalyst, not a newly discovered catalyst or evidence of industrial carbon-neutral operation.

evidence.tested: The paper reports 56 experimental observations and experimental validation of selected conditions for the target product ratio and CO faradaic efficiency.
evidence.unknown: Independent replication and performance outside stated assay conditions are not established.
evidence.ai_role: ML models trained on experimental outcomes estimate selectivity across fabrication and electrolysis parameters; inverse search proposes conditions for follow-up testing.

source_review.scope: Primary author manuscript PDF read through abstract, results and conditions; exact online date from source ledger, issue metadata says 2024.
